explication: Switch is a keyboard-driven macOS window switcher. The main workflow is a user hotkey opening the picker, which refreshes and orders window data, displays a filterable selection, and focuses the chosen window; cross-Space selection can move a window to the current Space. Separate branches cover settings, onboarding permissions, menu-bar access, and built-in updates. Source excerpts and the index support the core call links; README-documented capabilities are included where implementation details were not sampled.
